summary: [FE FEATURE 01] Authentication, Session & Password Lifecycle — UI End-to-End Scenario
description:
h1. Feature Scenario 01 — Authentication, Session & Password Lifecycle

*Actor(s):* All authenticated actors + anonymous login
*Business value / goal:* المستخدم يدخل إلى الـ workspace الصحيح بصلاحياته الحالية وليس من الـ Role فقط.
*Preconditions:* Account provisioned, active; managers/temporary-password users may require first-login change.

h2. Visual journey

{{Login → Current User → First-login gate (if needed) → Actor workspace → Logout/session expiry locally; Forgot Password is a separate recovery path.}}

h2. Connected screen → endpoint → next-step flow

# Login screen → POST /api/v1/auth/login; handle credentials and passwordChangeRequired.
# On success → GET /api/v1/auth/me; store userType, current roles, permissions and nullable scoped IDs.
# If passwordChangeRequired → POST /api/v1/auth/change-password; then re-login/reload /auth/me; block other features beforehand.
# Forgot-password screen → POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password/request-otp → verify-otp → reset; then return to Login.
# Route to Doctor onboarding or DoctorPractice, Reception, Patient, SuperAdmin, DrugCatalogManager or MedicalCatalogManager ONLY with current user state and permission.

h2. Branches, negative scenarios & guardrails

Incorrect/inactive 401; permission 403; OTP/reset 422/expired; no JWT/session in local unsafe logs; managers never gain clinical access.

h2. Reusable UI integration rules

* Treat all paths listed above as backend routes, not guessed Angular URLs. Resolve IDs from preceding API responses/options; never invent IDs or client-derived state transitions.
* Display loading, empty, success, 401/403/404, 409 optimistic concurrency/idempotency and 422 validation states. Translate display messages using API ProblemDetails stable errors[].code; support ar/en.
* Mutation uses exact documented body, fresh Idempotency-Key when required, and latest opaque rowVersion; after 409 fetch authoritative detail/actions, do not blindly retry.
* Gate buttons with server permissions + AvailableActions/current scope/status. Hiding a UI action never replaces backend authorization.
* Make each screen mobile-friendly and accessible; no patient PHI or credentials in logs/URLs/caches.

h2. Screen acceptance tests

* End-to-end journey works using IDs produced by previous screens; no database/manual state manipulation.
* Actor with permission/scope succeeds; wrong actor/practice/patient is denied.
* Empty/full/late/expired/stale/error states are explicitly rendered wherever relevant.
* After mutation, refresh detail, history, downstream list and any affected capabilities.
* No backend-only completion claim is confused with frontend delivery or production release.

*Depends on:* None; prerequisite to protected UI journeys.

description:
h1. Feature Scenario 16: Longitudinal Medical Record, Treating Scope & Visibility

*Actor(s):* Patient / treating Doctor / approved family access where legally enabled
*Business outcome:* المريض يراجع مساره الطبي المركزي مع خصوصية دقيقة؛ الطبيب يرى ما تسمح به العلاقة والسياسة فقط.
*Preconditions:* Completed clinical outputs; valid patient link; privacy/relationship authorization; some production sharing gates may be disabled.

h2. Ordered user journey

{{Patient Medical Overview → Timeline → Encounter/Item → Private Attachment; treating Doctor Ticket → Scoped Medical Overview → Visibility/Hidden Access Consent → Permitted Item.}}

h2. API-driven screen transitions

# Patient GET /api/v1/patients/me/medical-record/overview and /timeline (paged); open /encounters/{encounterId} or /items/{resourceType}/{sourceId}.
# Private content only via GET /api/v1/patients/me/medical-record/items/{resourceType}/{sourceId}/attachments/{attachmentId}/content; GET /access-log for privacy transparency.
# Doctor treating current Ticket GET /api/v1/doctors/me/practices/{practiceId}/tickets/{ticketId}/medical-record/overview|timeline, then item/detail and secured attachments.
# Doctor visibility workflow PATCH /api/v1/doctors/me/practices/{practiceId}/encounters/{encounterId}/visibility; GET /visibility/history.
# Hidden/limited history request: Doctor POST /api/v1/doctors/me/practices/{practiceId}/tickets/{ticketId}/medical-record/access-requests; owner Doctor inbox GET /api/v1/doctors/me/medical-record-access-requests/inbox, decide approve/reject/revoke.
# Dependent mode only via /api/v1/families/mine/medical-record-dependents then /dependents/{dependentPatientId}/medical-record/... with server-granted relationship.

h2. Negative / alternative paths & business constraints

Permission alone never grants arbitrary patient medical read; family != consent; no global admin clinical override; 403/404/429/503 must be handled. Privacy/legal approval required to enable disabled sharing features.

h2. Frontend implementation contract

* This is a UI/Angular integration Story, NOT a new backend feature. Existing API cards remain authoritative for per-route DTO required fields, enums, rowVersions and permissions.
* Resolve all IDs from server-provided lists/options/details; retain current filters/AsOfUtc/tokens for related navigation. Do not guess API values, pricing, permissions or state transitions.

* Keep sensitive patient, medical, contact, payment and internal diagnostic details out of logs/browser-visible arbitrary URLs. Private downloads require authentication per request.

h2. Acceptance criteria

* Route chain works end-to-end from returned IDs, with no manual DB manipulation.
* Actor-permission denial and cross-Practice/patient data isolation verified.
* Empty/denied/stale/partial/disabled-feature states are explicit and accessible.
* After each successful mutation refresh detail/versions/history and affected reports/counters.

h1. Feature Scenario 25: Drug & Medical Catalog Managers, Imports & Missing-Item Review

*Actor(s):* Root SuperAdmin / DrugCatalogManager / MedicalCatalogManager / Doctor requester
*Business outcome:* مدير Reference Catalog يراجع المصطلحات والاستيراد وطلبات الدكاترة بدون الوصول إلى المرضى أو نتائجهم الطبية.
*Preconditions:* Root-created manager account, first-login password gate passed, correct catalog-specific permission.

h2. Ordered user journey

{{Root Manager Accounts → First Login Password Change → Catalog List/Search → Create/Update/Import Preview → Review Staged Changes → Apply → Doctor Missing-Item Request → Review/Approve/Reject.}}

h2. API-driven screen transitions

# Root GET/POST /api/v1/admin/drug-catalog-managers and /api/v1/admin/medical-catalog-managers; activate/deactivate manager.
# Manager Login → Change Password → GET /api/v1/auth/me; render separate Drug vs Medical workspace only for owned permissions.
# Drug: GET/POST/PUT /api/v1/admin/drug-catalog; activate/deactivate/merge; POST /api/v1/admin/drug-catalog/imports/preview → GET imports/{batchId}/changes → POST /apply.
# Medical: GET/POST/PUT /api/v1/admin/lab-catalog and /api/v1/admin/radiology-catalog; respective imports/preview, batch history, changes, apply/discard.
# Doctor submits GET/POST /api/v1/doctors/me/drug-catalog-requests, /lab-catalog-requests or /radiology-catalog-requests when missing.
# Catalog manager GET /api/v1/admin/*-catalog-requests; view request, request-more-info, approve/reject as appropriate; refresh catalog search.

h2. Negative / alternative paths & business constraints

No direct clinical/order/result/Prescription authority from manager role. Official LOINC and Radiology imports need reviewed package and source fidelity; no automatic destructive merge. Keep staged conflict items pending when needed.

h2. Frontend implementation contract

* This is a UI/Angular integration Story, NOT a new backend feature. Existing API cards remain authoritative for per-route DTO required fields, enums, rowVersions and permissions.
* Resolve all IDs from server-provided lists/options/details; retain current filters/AsOfUtc/tokens for related navigation. Do not guess API values, pricing, permissions or state transitions.
* Handle loading, empty, partial/unavailable, success, 401/403/404/409/422/429/503. Use localized ProblemDetails stable errors[].code; refresh on stale version, never auto-replay a conflicting mutation.
* Honor actor+current permission+Practice scope+resource relationship+AvailableActions; do not treat UI visibility as an authorization grant. For writes, follow the source route Idempotency-Key and opaque RowVersion contracts.
* Keep sensitive patient, medical, contact, payment and internal diagnostic details out of logs/browser-visible arbitrary URLs. Private downloads require authentication per request.

h2. Acceptance criteria

* Route chain works end-to-end from returned IDs, with no manual DB manipulation.
* Actor-permission denial and cross-Practice/patient data isolation verified.
* Empty/denied/stale/partial/disabled-feature states are explicit and accessible.
* After each successful mutation refresh detail/versions/history and affected reports/counters.
* Arabic/English UI and responsive/mobile states are correct.

*Depends on:* Feature 01, Doctor onboarding 02; supplies medication/diagnostic UI 13–15.

h2. Cross-cutting UI API integration rules

* *Identity:* Use the API's own patientId, doctorPracticeId, reservationId, ticketId, encounterId, paymentId, claimId, notificationId, requestId and returned detailRoute as opaque separate identifiers. No client-generated relations.
* *Authorization:* authentication + live permission + active actor + current Practice assignment/ownership + Patient/self/clinical relationship + resource state. Button hide is only a UI hint; every destination reauthorizes.
* *Concurrency:* preserve latest RowVersion, reconcile 409 from server detail; preserve exact idempotency key only for retrying the identical mutation.
* *Booking:* availability, Segment quota, effective Practice schedule and prices come from backend at commit. NoShow/Late is not interchangeable. Reservation is booked intention; Ticket is attended queue; Encounter is clinical.
* *API errors:* 400 binding, 401 login, 403 forbidden, privacy-hiding 404, 409 race/transition, 422 validation, 429 Retry-After, 503 unavailable. Show translated message + stable code, never hardcode business decisions.
* *Reports/exports:* share normalized scope/date filters and AsOfUtc through dashboard → report → drilldown → export. Render unavailable KPI as unavailable, not fake zero. Export has independent permission and bounded size.
* *Patient privacy:* no private media as public static URL; attachment download is authorized per attempt. Handle withheld/HIDDEN data honestly, never reveal PHI in notifications/reports/logs.
* *Archive:* historical detail preserves same logical ID and read-only state. Opaque cursor is scope/filter-bound. Archive worker is disabled until independently approved activation; no archive UI action should imply live production relocation.
* *Localization/UX:* ar/en and accessible mobile layouts; for every route include loading, empty, disabled, unauthorized, stale, rate-limited and retry states.
